replies.author: Upset_Camel5568
replies.body:
I have a folder of reference images covering buildings, stalls, shrines, temples, and other assets. My current workflow uses Fable 5.1 as the orchestrator, managing 10 agents, each with their own role within a fictional game development company. I also have two additional research agents focused on areas such as graphics, audio, models etc.

Each agent then interacts with the Godot API to carry out assigned tasks. I use a custom model viewer and level viewer/editor to review progress and provide direction to Fable. I create storyboards and level plans in [draw.io](http://draw.io) which are then passed to Fable who then allocates tasks to the appropriate agent.

This is the workflow I am currently using. If I complete the project, my intention is to release it for free.
